snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer November 2026 | Rites of Accord
snippet.description:
Every faction breaks the rules.

Rites of Accord is turn-based hex tactics with six radically asymmetric factions, set in a hopeful vision of future Earth where techno-tribes settle their conflicts through ceremonial digital battles instead of war.

👻 The Veilbound raise the dead as Echoes.
🌱 Symbiont Ethos spread living terrain.
❄️ Glacial Chorus share damage across the Choir.
☀️ Solar Nomadry follow the sun and dive from the sky.

Four factions are playable now, with all six at launch. Ranked 1v1, a Survival roguelite and a campaign, with matches of 30 to 40 minutes. The full game comes to Steam in April 2027.

Play the free browser beta on PC or mobile: https://ritesofaccord.com/?src=youtube
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4579700/Rites_of_Accord/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social
